verdict.rationale: Veo 3 generates sound effects and ambient noise natively, in the same generation as the video. Hands-on community reports confirm the audio is closely matched to the on-screen action. That satisfies the story's disjunctive requirement of sound effects, ambient audio, or music in the same tool. Missing for 10: documented native music generation (one user saw break dancers with no music), and documented controls for adding or adjusting audio on an existing scene rather than only at generation time.

support.subject: As a creator, I can add generated sound effects, ambient audio, or music matched to the scene in the same tool

citations.quote: Veo 3 lets you add sound effects, ambient noise, and even dialogue to your creations – generating all audio natively.
Introducing Veo 3, our video generation model with expanded creative controls – including native audio and extended videos.
Blown away at how well the audio/video matches up
the audio integration really makes a huge difference, especially given it does both sounds and voices.
